regions.merged_text: · SIN - VENIAL - MORTAL Venial sin stressed as in a way more dangerous than mortal for a religious, though incomparably less heinous in itself. It paves the way to mortal sin, blinding the soul as to the terrible consequences of the latter. Is is, however, an offense against GOD HIMSELF .... To escape a lions jaws one would not hesitate to poke himself into a cluster of thorns. Venial sin not itself vital.
